items.title: Head and Neck Tumor Lesion Segmentation, Diagnosis and Prognosis
items.description:
This book constitutes the 4th 3D Head and Neck Tumor Segmentation in PET/CT Challenge, HECKTOR 2025, which was held in conjunction with the 28th International Conference on Medical Image Computing and Computer-Assisted Intervention, MICCAI 2026, on September 2025. 

 The 15 full papers included in this book were carefully reviewed and selected from 15 submissions. They were organized in topical sections as follows: Tumor and Lymph Node Segmentation; Joint Learning: Segmentation with Prognosis and/or HPV Prediction; and Downstream Prediction from PET/CT and Clinical Data.

items.title: Blockchain – ICBC 2026
items.description:
This book constitutes the proceedings of the 9th International Conference on Blockchain – ICBC 2026, held as part of the Services Conference Federation, SCF 2026, which took place in Kuala Lumpur during August 2026. 

The 6 full papers and 1 short papers included in this book were carefully reviewed and selected from 21 submissions. ICBC 2026 provides an international forum for both researchers and industry practitioners to exchange the latest fundamental advances in the state-of-the-art technologies and best practices of blockchain, as well as emerging standards and research topics.

items.title: XR-Revolution im Business
items.description:
Erfahren Sie, wie Sie mit XR, VR, MR, AR, Spatial Computing und KI für Ihr Unternehmen zukunftsfähig machen. Dieses Buch begleitet Sie von der ursprünglichen Technologieauswahl, über Testing, Integration bis hin zur aktiven Nutzung. Praxisnahe Usecases zeigen Ihnen mögliche Einsatzmöglichkeiten auf, von Lernen, Training, Prototyping, Wartung bis hin zur Marketing- und Salesuntersützung. Mit diesem Buch mit begleitendem Online-Kurs erhalten Sie eine Gebrauchsanweisung für den technologischen Wandel Ihres Unternehmens. Den Zugang zum Online-Kurs finden Sie direkt im Buch. 

 

Stichpunkte: 
 
 Grundwissen XR, VR, MR, AR, Spatial Computing und KI 
 Auswahl der Technologie bis zur erfolgreichen Integration 
 Konkrete Usecasebeispiele 
 Evaluierung von Sicherheitsstandards und Compliance

items.title: AI and Ethics Handbook
items.description:
This Handbook summarizes in everyday language the ethical, regulatory, and policy implications that arise from the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI). Designed to bridge the gap between technical and non-technical professionals, it focuses on where AI techniques, tools, and technologies may lead in the future. Particular attention is given to the potential intentional and unintentional misuses of AI, and how these misuses may be prevented. 

Coverage includes: 
 
 Ethical questions and concerns that arise from basic research and the design and use of practical applications of AI 
 Regulatory frameworks and guidelines, including self-regulation and constraints, and controls on development and implementation of AI technologies 
 Emergent public policy and the possibility of legislative interventions linked to current and future ethical issues related to the use of AI technologies and their applications 
 How to balance the relation between technology-law-society 
 Data provenance and validity

items.title: Proceedings of 2025 International Conference on Medical Imaging and Computer-Aided Diagnosis (MICAD 2025)
items.description: This book share insights into extracting and understanding more information from medical images, which drives the need for new and innovative solutions. The combination of digital image processing and computer vision has led to the development of computer-aided diagnosis (CAD), a key tool in disease analysis. The 2025 International Conference on Medical Imaging and Computer-Aided Diagnosis warmly welcomes researchers, scholars, engineers, scientists, industry professionals, and graduate students working in these areas. It offers a platform to share ideas, encourage interdisciplinary collaboration, and promote progress in medical imaging and CAD. Through engaging formats such as poster sessions and oral presentations, participants will gain valuable insights, showcase the latest advancements, build meaningful connections, and explore future applications.

items.title: Oracle Integration Cookbook for Oracle ERP Cloud
items.description:
The book begins by establishing a strong foundation, introducing OIC concepts, integration types, adapters, connections, fault handling, notifications, mappings, JavaScript, XSLT, projects, and monitoring capabilities. It then dives deep into the heart of Oracle ERP Cloud integrations, covering REST, SOAP, FTP, ATP databases, Object Storage, Visual Builder, BI Publisher, UCM Web Center, and ERP Business Events. Readers are guided through detailed, step-by-step demos including FBDI-based integrations, callback patterns, event-driven architectures, advanced REST and SOAP use cases, file-based processing, parallel and data-stitch activities, massive data loads, and delta-based processing between runs. 

The final chapters and appendices provide advanced demos, troubleshooting techniques, Postman and SoapUI usage, reusable samples, and best practices, making the book an invaluable reference for both day-to-day delivery work and long-term architecture design. By the end of this book, readers will not only understand how Oracle ERP Cloud integrations work, but will also have the confidence and practical knowledge to design, build, monitor, and optimize robust, scalable, and production-ready integration solutions using Oracle Integration Cloud. 

 You Will: 
 
 Design, build, and monitor end-to-end integrations between Oracle ERP Cloud and external systems using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) 
 Implement and troubleshoot real-world integration scenarios using REST, SOAP, FTP, FBDI, ERP Business Events, ATP databases, Object Storage, and Visual Builder 
 Apply advanced integration patterns including callbacks, event-driven flows, parallel processing, massive data loads, delta processing, fault handling, and production best practices 
 

This book is for : Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) developers, Oracle ERP Cloud consultants and integration architects

items.title: Arduino Assembly Language
items.description:
This book explores how to use Assembly Language within your Arduino sketches, directly from the Arduino IDE, without any external tools. By learning to write low-level code, you’ll gain the ability to reduce sketch size, increase execution speed, and achieve precise timing control, especially useful for tasks like bit-banging communication protocols. It’s designed to be both educational and practical, helping developers and makers to reduce the size of their sketches, increase the speed of execution, and to get a much better understanding of how the Arduino hardware works. With a focus on clarity and hands-on examples, it’s ideal for developers and makers who want to push their Arduino projects further and gain deeper insight into microcontroller programming. 

 What You'll Learn 

• How to code in Assembly for speed, code size and exact timings. • How to write libraries for use with Assembly (and C++ for some of the libraries). • How to interact with all the hardware features of the ATmega328P, from Assembly Language. • What to avoid and other pitfalls. 

 Who Is This Book For 

Everyone with an interest in the Arduino boards based on the ATmega328P. All levels but a passing understanding of some programming languages would be helpful.

items.title: Cognitive Semantic Communication for Future Wireless Communications
items.description:
The rapid evolution of 6G networks demands communication systems that go beyond data transmission toward intelligent understanding. Semantic communication (SemCom) represents a paradigm shift from transmitting bits to transmitting meaning. By integrating artificial intelligence, knowledge graphs, and reasoning capabilities, cognitive SemCom further enables networks to infer, interpret, and deliver only task-relevant information, thereby achieving higher efficiency, robustness, and explainability than classical SemCom architectures. 

This book provides a comprehensive overview of cognitive SemCom, from fundamental theories to practical implementations. It explores how structured knowledge can be used for semantic encoding, reasoning, compression, and robust signal recovery under interference, model mismatch, and adversarial attacks. Core topics include UAV-enabled cognitive SemCom systems, multi-user and multi-modal resource allocation, and cross-layer semantic security. The book also demonstrates how semantic communication can support low-latency, energy-efficient, and intelligence-native 6G systems. 

Designed for researchers, engineers, and graduate students in wireless communications, signal processing, and artificial intelligence, this book bridges communication theory with machine intelligence. Readers will gain a deep understanding of how cognitive abilities transform communication from symbol transmission to meaning exchange, and how these innovations enable future intelligent networks.

items.title: Human-Computer Interaction
items.description:
This book constitutes the revised selected papers of the 11th Iberoamerican Workshop on Human-Computer Interaction, HCI-COLLAB 2025, in Zacatecas, Mexico, in May 7–9, 2025. 

The 23 full papers included in this volume were carefully selected and reviewed from 105 submissions. They reflect the thematic and methodological diversity of contemporary HCI, encompassing areas such as multimodal interaction, artificial intelligence, user experience, accessibility, extended reality, and collaborative systems.

items.title: Intelligent Computing and Technologies
items.description:
This book constitutes the refereed proceedings of the Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Technologies , ICTCon 2025 , held in Kokrajhar, India , during December 2–3, 2025 . 

The 36 full papers presented in this volume were carefully reviewed and selected from 136 submissions. They are organized into the following topical sections: Computer Vision; Artificial Intelligence; Data Science; and Trends and Technologies.

items.title: Security and Privacy in Cyber-Physical Systems and Smart Vehicles
items.description:
This book constitutes the refereed proceedings of the Third EAI International Conference on Security and Privacy in Cyber-Physical Systems and Smart Vehicles, SmartSP 2025, held in Salt lake City, UT, USA, during December 1–2, 2025. 

 The 10 full papers, 6 short papers, 2 special tracks, and 2 demo papers included in this book were carefully reviewed and selected from 48 submissions. They are organized into the following topical sections: Secure CPS and IoT; Attacks against CPS and IoT; Threat Detection and ML Security; and Special Topic: Human-Machine Interfaces in Smart Vehicles.

items.title: Performance Evaluation Methodologies and Tools
items.description: This book constitutes the refereed proceedings of the 18th EAI International Conference on Performance Evaluation Methodologies and Tools , Valuetools 2025, which took place in Glasgow , UK during December 11–12, 2025 The 18 full papers presented in this volume were carefully reviewed and selected from 46 submissions. They were organized into topical sections as follows: Queueing Models; Stochastic Models; Cyber Attacks; Tools; Networks and Routing.

items.title: Software Engineering and Advanced Applications
items.description:
This two-volume set constitutes the refereed proceedings of the 52nd Euromicro Conference on Software Engineering and Advanced Applications, SEAA 2026, held in Kraków, Poland, during September 2–4, 2026. 

The 50 full papers and 22 short papers were carefully reviewed and selected from 146 submissions.These papers were organized in the following topical sections: 

Part I: Cyber-Physical Systems; Data and AI Driven Engineering; Model-Driven Engineering and Modeling Languages; Emerging Computing Technologies; Practical Aspects of Software Engineering; Explainable and Trustworthy Applications. Part II: Model-Driven Engineering and Modeling Languages; Software Management: Measurement, Peopleware, and Innovation; Systematic Literature Reviews and Mapping Studies in Software Engineering; Software Process and Product Improvement; Software Analytics: Mining Software Open Datasets and Repositories.

items.title: Design of Cyber-Secure Critical Infrastructure
items.description:
This book constitutes the refereed proceedings of the First International Conference on Design of Cyber-Secure Critical Infrastructure, DCS-CI 2026, held in Buford, GA, USA, during September 2-3, 2026. 

The 9 full papers presented in this volume were carefully reviewed and selected from 30 submissions. Also, it contains 3 papers from DCS-Water 2025. 

DCS-CI (Design of Cyber-Secure Critical Infrastructure) is a joint academic-industrial forum that brings together researchers from academia, industry practitioners, and policymakers to discuss recent advances in securing and strengthening the resilience of critical infrastructure systems across energy, water, transportation, and other sectors. The DCS-CI series has its origins in the DCS-Water conferences started in 2024, which focused specifically on the cybersecurity challenges facing water and wastewater utilities.

items.title: Management of Digital EcoSystems
items.description:
This two-set volume CCIS 3103-3104 constitutes the proceedings of the 17th International Conference on Management of Digital EcoSystems, MEDES 2025, held in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, during November 24–26, 2025. 

The 46 full papers and 12 short papers included in these volumes were carefully reviewed and selected from 96 submissions. They are organized into topical sections as follows: 

Part I: Education and Learning; Deep Learning; Smart Cities; Parallel and Distributed Architectures; Modeling and Ontologies; AI Theoretical Issues; Health and Medical Issues; Theoretical Issues; AI Technical Issues; and Applications.
 
Part II: Workshop: AI-SBKE,Workshop: DEPRWorld,Workshop: AI-Driven MultiGIS and Student Track.

items.title: Document Analysis Systems
items.description:
This book constitutes the proceedings of the 17th IAPR International workshops on Document Analysis Systems, DAS 2026, which took place in conjunctions with ICDAR 2026, in Vienna, Austria, during September 3-4, 2026. 

The 29 full papers included in this book were carefully reviewed and selected from 50 submissions. They were organized in topical sections as follows: Tables, Forms and Structured Extraction; Document-Centric AI, Retrieval and REasoning; Handwriting, Writer Identification and Music Documents; OCR, Layout and Recognition Systems; Enterprise and Industrial Document AI; and Historical, Symbolic and Camera-Based Documents.

items.title: Immersive Technology Unveiled
items.description:
Immersive Technology is revolutionizing the present and future. It includes virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), and mixed reality (MR) to extend reality by engaging the handler in a virtual environment through applications in domains such as web application, healthcare, transportation, construction, gaming, etc. This book focuses on immersive technology where VR headsets create a simulator environment and an individual immerse into it to get the experience of completely different reality. 


The book provides knowledge about the fundamentals and scope of VR, AR and MR. It discusses machine learning, artificial intelligence, internet of things, cloud computing, and many other pillars that plays a vital role in the revolution of immersive technology. This book also discusses some case studies that will be beneficial for industries that are dealing with smart wearable gadgets. 


Readers will learn a complete perspective of immersive technologies from the technical details and real-life use-cases to its social, cultural, and business contexts. 


 


 You Will 

 
 Explains through examples along with code how to practically develop AR, VR, and MR applications 
 Shows how interactive technology can interact with physical movements 
 Demonstrates how to provide more intuitive and interaction-less experiences within immersive spaces 
 


 


 Who Is This Book For 


Beginner to Intermediate level readers with interest in AR development would benefit from this book.

items.title: Health in the Era of Digitalization
items.description:
This book provides a concise overview of the effects of digitalization and how they will affect healthcare provision in the coming years. Chapters focus on specific problems currently encountered in healthcare and how digital health techniques can or could potentially be used to improve provision in the future. Particular attention is given to subjects relevant to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, enabling the reader to develop a broad understanding of the fundamental concepts and subjects relevant to medical management in the digital age. 
 Health in the Era of Digitalization systematically describes the potential for digitalization to change healthcare provision for a variety of disorders and as a result of global crises. Its multi-disciplinary and problem-solving focus ensure it is a crucial resource for all those involved in relevant policy-making positions or with a general interest in the topic.

items.title: Systems, Software and Services Process Improvement and Innovation
items.description:
This two-volume set CCIS 3136-3137 constitutes the refereed proceedings of the 33rd European Conference on Systems, Software and Services Process Improvement and Innovation, EuroSPI 2026, held in Cairo, Egypt, during September 8–10, 2026. 

The 42 full papers included in these volumes were carefully reviewed and selected from 60 submissions. They are organized into the following topical sections: 

Part I: Digitalisation of Industry, Infrastructure and E-Mobility; High Maturity Organisations; Innovation and Sustainability ; SPI and Functional Safety and Cybersecurity.
